app_fee.value: Saint Louis University application portal does not require an application fee for graduate admission.
app_fee.quote: SLU's application portal does not require an application fee.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged by the SLU portal, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: SLU's application portal does not require an application fee.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required at the university level; individual departments set their own testing requirements.
gre_general.quote: Each department has different requirement standards for graduate admission tests such as the GRE. Contact the individual program or department for specific information regarding test scores and other admission requirements.

toefl_min.value: The graduate minimum is TOEFL iBT 80; some graduate programs may require more.

also.quote: Graduate programs may have higher minimums

ielts_min.value: The graduate minimum is an IELTS band of 6.5.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the catalog's list of English-speaking countries exempt from proof of English, and a degree from India is not listed as an exemption, so a test is required.
english_waiver.quote: International applicants who are citizens of the English-speaking countries listed below are not required to submit proof of English language proficiency

notes: Source: catalog.slu.edu 2026-2027 pages (the only SLU pages that fetched; www.slu.edu returned 502 for every page tried). The catalog's exemption list is for citizens of listed countries; the high-school-in-English exemption covers high school only. Recheck the 2027-2028 catalog when it is published.
